title: Denver Pedicab Brewery Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Only Adults 21 years old and above are allowed to drink any alcoholic beverages
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on an unforgettable pedicab journey through Denver's rich brewing history and vibrant art scene. Your adventure begins at the historic Tivoli Brewing Company, where you'll delve into the origins of Colorado's beer culture in an iconic setting. Next, explore Wynkoop Brewery, a trailblazer in craft brewing, set in a historic building that melds tradition with innovation. As your tour culminates in the RiNo Art District, you're invited to choose from a selection of unique breweries, each offering a taste of Denver's diverse beer styles. This experience is not just about sampling exquisite brews; it's a sensory voyage through the heart of the city, where every sip is accompanied by stunning street art and tales of Denver's past and present. This pedicab tour offers a perfect blend of historical insight, local flavors, and artistic splendor, making it an essential experience for both beer aficionados and culture enthusiasts alike.
